sources.entry: TrelloApp - Unofficial wrapper application for Trello.com written in Swift. This is almost a "Hello World" for a site specific browser.

summary.one_liner: TrelloApp is an unofficial, minimal Swift wrapper app that loads Trello.com in a dedicated window as a site-specific browser.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes TrelloApp as an unofficial wrapper application for Trello.com written in Swift. It is presented as a very small example of a site-specific browser, meaning a native app that wraps a single website. The README does not describe any features beyond that. It includes only a one-line description and the MIT-style license text, with no build or usage instructions.
use_cases: wrap Trello.com in a standalone desktop app
learn how to build a site-specific browser in Swift
example of a minimal Swift wrapper app
run Trello outside a browser tab on macOS
notable: Minimal site-specific browser example, described as almost a Hello World
Listed in an open-source macOS apps collection under Productivity
caveats: README gives no setup, build, or usage instructions
Unofficial project, not endorsed by Trello
Copyright notice is from 2014, so the project may be dated
